remarks:
Welcome to 4955 Seneca Street! This private oasis is set back on an acre of property overlooking Cazenovia Creek offering a flexible floor plan and a backyard view that changes with every season. The large driveway, with a turn around, allows for private parking ample enough for any occasion. 

Ranch? Cape Cod? You decide. The layout lives comfortably with everything you need on the first floor, while the second story provides extra space to use as you see fit. 

The living room and dining area are spacious, open and set apart by decorative columns that give each space its own character without limitation. The well appointed kitchen is bright, well laid out and simplifies cooking for one or many. Featuring a custom built in bar area, all appliances and an additional eating space this kitchen is sure to be the heart of your new home. Just beyond is an office or den that opens to the Florida room and patio, where the view shifts from the backyard to the woods and the creek beyond.

The first floor primary suite includes laundry with the washer and dryer staying, double vanities, a walk in shower, and a walk in jetted tub for enjoyment and accessibility. A second full bathroom on the first floor adds convenience for guests and everyday living.

Upstairs are two additional rooms that can serve as bedrooms, a hobby space or anything that works for your lifestyle. One of those rooms being a massive 10x32 with endless possibilities. 

The full basement offers an impressive amount of storage and is equipped with two hot water tanks, a high efficiency furnace and a 150 amp electrical service. It is the perfect blank slate to expand living space if desired. To add further peace of mind in any weather this home comes equipped with a permanent Generac generator.

Square footage differs from the tax records due to the finished bonus room.
